purpose: leave-one-material-out transferability of the five-q EPC adapter latent prior
data_policy: stored E17/E18/E21/E24 vertex arrays only; no new DFT or q labels

protocol.B1: five labels, SVD rank r_m, degree-4 Chebyshev (deployed baseline)
protocol.B2(k): k evenly spaced labels, degree k-1 Chebyshev (label reduction, no prior)
protocol.P(k): k labels, degree-4 Chebyshev, ridge toward LOMO prior latent coefficients

gates.decision: prior transfers iff G1 and G2 hold for all four materials; else keep five labels per system

ridge_note: P(k) reports the best holdout RMSE over the mu grid; if even the best mu gives no benefit over B2(k) the prior does not transfer
